youtube.title: Stompy's Rhyme Time! (STOMP!) | Nerdy Noodles
youtube.description:
🦖 STOMP! Stompy the dino stomped so hard that all the rhyming words bounced away! Can you help Stompy find them?

Learn rhyming words with Stompy: dog and frog, star and car, moon and balloon! Each word comes back in its own place (the park, the pond, outer space, the road and the night sky), and you hear the REAL sounds of the dog, the frog and the car. Then sing the rhyme time song, and stay till the end, because something silly is hiding behind the board! 👀

Perfect for toddlers, preschoolers and kindergarten kids (ages 2-6).

✨ In this video, kids will:
✔️ Learn what rhyming words are
✔️ Hear 3 rhyming pairs: dog/frog, star/car, moon/balloon
✔️ Notice the matching word endings: -og, -ar, -oon
✔️ Sing a rhyming song with Stompy!

⏱️ Chapters
0:00 Hello from Stompy!
0:04 STOMP! Oh no!
0:09 Let's find the rhymes!
0:26 Sing along!
0:46 What's behind the board?
0:56 What rhymes with cat?

💬 What rhymes with cat? Tell Stompy in the comments!
